about_the_game:
Traverse all of Sanctuary with the Dark Pathways Pack.

Includes:

  • 1000 Platinum

  • Hell and Back Bundle:

    • Tempest Gate Sorcerer Town Portal

    • Transit Artery Rogue Town Portal

    • Netherworld Threshold Necromancer Town Portal

    • Wildroot Way Druid Town Portal

    • Warpath Barbarian Town Portal

Dark Pathways:

Go forth and conquer.

Platinum can be exchanged to customize your in-game experience with purchasable cosmetic items from the Shop and to unlock access to the Deluxe Battle Pass Bundle and the Premium Battle Pass Bundle.
